Except for Tony wasn’t truly trying to kill Steve and Steve wasn’t truly trying to kill Tony. We’ll never know who would have actually won.

What we did learn though right before Steve uses the shield to take out Tony’s arc reactor in his suit is that for a brief moment Tony truly thought Steve was going to kill him. Did Steve consider actually ending Tony? It’s hard to say because that’s where Steve has a leg up on Tony, he’s usually more in control of his emotions and even facial expressions. But Tony’s face says it all. He thought Steve was going to kill him. In that moment Tony thought that could be part of Steve’s character. In my opinion that’s the biggest takeaway from Civil War and why it’s so crushing. Do I think Steve was going to kill Tony? No (I’m team Cap BTW), but what’s more important is that Tony thought Steve was ready to do so.
